head_change.subject: hotfix: isolate sync restart regression fixture
head_change.summary: Starts the pre-existing PID-intent test process from its temporary dev-root checkout so the test cannot reset the surrounding exact-head review worktree after origin/dev advances.

owner_review.identity_constraint: Codex and Codex2 are the same review identity and do not supply the independent verdict.
owner_review.authorization_gate: The signed task acceptance remains bound to d9a27f972fb8f9184a8dc15256d8ad8223948a8e. The current PR head 671a15e7dbf4ba278482fa7764a07d3972ae7237 must not be approved or merged without auditable Human/Ops exact-head authorization or a replacement signed packet.

semantic_findings.acceptance: A live active-root/dev-root mismatch is restart-worthy even when code and config are unchanged.
semantic_findings.evidence: root_split is initialized to 0, set to 1 only for a resolved active root unequal to DEV_ROOT, and participates in the restart condition.

semantic_findings.acceptance: Restart intent stays PID-bound and is recorded before SIGTERM.
semantic_findings.evidence: The existing watchdog --record-intent-pid/--record-intent-target call remains before kill -TERM, and failure to record intent exits without killing the process.

semantic_findings.acceptance: A matching active root with no code/config change remains a no-op.
semantic_findings.evidence: root_split remains 0 for ACTIVE_ROOT == DEV_ROOT and the new negative regression passes.

semantic_findings.acceptance: The hotfix is bounded to the two declared files.
semantic_findings.evidence: GitHub PR file enumeration and origin/dev...exact-head diff both contain only scripts/sync-dev-root.sh and scripts/test_sync_dev_root.py.

verification.reason_for_environment: Prevents the pre-existing PID-intent test from treating the detached review checkout itself as the live active root and syncing that checkout to the newer origin/dev during the suite.

verification.execution_root: detached worktree at d9a27f972fb8f9184a8dc15256d8ad8223948a8e with current origin/dev
verification.classification: disclosed harness self-mutation; independent reviewer must decide whether it blocks
verification.detail: test_sync_records_pid_bound_intent_before_stopping_live_supervisor starts its fake live process in the review worktree. Because PR #4451 is one base commit behind current dev, sync-dev-root.sh sees that worktree as a split active root and hard-resets it to origin/dev. The following two new tests are then collected from the exact-head module but invoke the reset dev version of the shell script. The two tests pass alone and the full suite passes when active-root syncing of the runner checkout is disabled.
